releaseNotes.sw: Marekebisho: kitufe cha kufunga (X) kinafanya kazi, aina ya mwaliko inafunguka kwa kubofya mara mbili, na jina/aina vinaweza kuwekwa popote kwenye kadi.
releaseNotes.en: Fixes: the close (X) buttons work, invitation type opens font/color on double-tap, and guest name/type can be placed anywhere on the card.
